name: Zoe
source:
She’s a very shy and quiet girl. She’s usually kind and sweet. She’s a PhD Engineering student, and works in the same scholarship project as Tirs, Quim and Ren. She has a small crush on Tirs, but although she tells about it to Quim, she doesn’t dare to say anything to Tirs.

[From Casting Call]
